## Load in data and libraries

```{r}
PimaIndians <- read.csv("Healthcare-Diabetes.csv")
IraqDataset <- read.csv("Dataset of Diabetes .csv")

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
```

## Filter IraqDataset for Women only

```{r}
IraqDataset <- filter(IraqDataset, Gender == "F")
```

## Setup of first analysis (HbA1c vs Glucose levels)

## HbA1c levels determined by the Cleaveland Clinc

## Glucose levels determined by the American Heart Association

```{r}
PimaIndians <- PimaIndians %>%
  mutate(DiabetesStatus = case_when(
    Glucose < 100  ~ "Normal",
    Glucose < 126  ~ "Pre-Diabetic",
    Glucose >= 126 ~ "Diabetic"))

IraqDataset <- IraqDataset %>%
  mutate(DiabetesStatus = (HbA1c*28.7) - 46.7)
```
